source_status: The complete MPP, LAP, DDP and NBP implementation sources were not found. The reconstruction uses the ROM for instructions, surviving interfaces for public fields, and later variable definitions for matching private names and relationships.

data_spans.description: Resource header with flags, block length and relative master-pointer offset.
Driver header with flags, five entry offsets, the Pascal name and a word in the conventional version slot.
Eight control offsets for selectors 242 through 249, relative to MPPDriver.
Four SCC register/value bytes consumed by StartFrame.
Five SCC value/register pairs and a zero-word terminator consumed by MPPClose.
The Pascal name .ATP, followed by a space for alignment.
Thirteen SCC value/register pairs and a zero-word terminator.
Three SCC value/register pairs and a zero-word terminator.
Six SCC bytes, the saved status-register value, a one-byte abort delay and one alignment byte.
The CmpString trap number read by GetTrapAddress; this word is data.
Seven NBP command offsets for selectors 249 through 255, relative to NBPCode.

boundaries.description: The resource block length covers the entire MPP driver, including its LAP hardware routines, lookup-reply code and NBP command code. The driver and two control tables resolve to complete entries. SkipDuplicateTuple ends with a backward branch at $41B6C6, immediately before the SERD resource header at $41B6C8.

name_provenance.description: The reference export names MPPControl and MPPOpen. PatchPlusROM confirms VBLHnd at $41AB1E. AppleTalk.a and piDDP.a document the ReadPacket/ReadRest calling convention; their two entries are identified from the A4 assignment and two-byte branch. Other routine and branch names are descriptive reconstructions.

changes.description: Restored the four protocol handlers and fourteen socket listeners without the later dynamic-socket array. Retained the surviving table names and their applicable comments. The MPP variables end at $A2.

Restored the original LAP variable layout through $FC. Backoff, collision and defer fields retain their later names and relationships. The original one-byte abort delay replaces the later timing-word array. Saved registers and SCC setup bytes retain their source names.
Retained the original low-memory and public packet equates. Restored private NBP offsets describe its 71-byte state block and 152-byte lookup buffer; their exact original names are unavailable.
Restored direct SCC polling, collision backoff, node probing, bridge discovery, frame checks and disk-driver polling. Preserved instruction ordering, register saves and delay operations.
Restored the two branch entries for ReadPacket and ReadRest. Preserved the surviving socket-listener contract about header storage, A4/A5 use and D2 preservation.
Retained the resident lookup-reply and NBP command code. NRPtr and LookupPtr still carry their source names and state flags even though the code is embedded in the ROM.

Expressed the resource and dispatch lengths with label differences. Represented SCC tables, names, copyright text and the trap-number constant as data. Every reachable instruction uses an assembly mnemonic or named trap.

Excluded later comments that describe a separate dynamic-socket table, a two-byte abort delay or statistics storage. Their corresponding offsets were restored to the smaller ROM layout. Other borrowed comments remain exact.

preserved_rom_behavior.description: The VBL task tests VBLDeferCnt and decrements it without masking interrupts. PatchPlusROM documents the January 1987 fix that prevents the counter from becoming negative. This source preserves the earlier operations and the patch diagnosis.
AllocateNBP retains the application-heap allocation trap skipped by the preceding short branch during the ordinary system-heap path.
ResetReceive retains MOVE.W (SP),(SP) between SCC writes. The source does not remove or replace this delay operation.

uncertain_header_word.description: The word immediately follows the aligned driver name and precedes the Control entry. OS/DeviceMgr.a lines 848 through 851 calculate this location as a driver-version field. No entry or direct reference to this word was found in the ROM code. Its high byte and use by this ROM remain unproven.

separate_runtime_version.description: MPPOpen writes 19 to DCtlQueue+1. OS/Gestalt/GestaltFunction.a lines 865 through 884 read that DCE byte for the AppleTalk version; they do not read MPPVersionWord.

uncertain_header_word.classification_limit: The slot convention supports treating this word as header data. It does not establish that the full value $2813 was a version number or that the Mac Plus Device Manager used it.

LAPTBLSZ.original: LAPTblSz		EQU		PHs						; Size of LAP protocol handler table (even)
LAPTBLSZ.restored: LAPTblSz EQU 4 ; Size of LAP protocol handler table (even)

DDPTBLSZ.original: DDPTblSz		EQU		SASs					; Size of socket table (even!)
DDPTBLSZ.restored: DDPTblSz EQU 14 ; Size of socket table (even!)

PROTOCOLS.original: Protocols		EQU		NumOfSkts+1				; List of active protocols
PROTOCOLS.restored: Protocols EQU ATPVars+4 ; List of active protocols

DDPTBLEND.original: DDPTblEnd		EQU		BigSktListen+(4*(MaxBigSkt-DDPMaxWKS))	; End of DAS table

MPPVARSEND.original: MPPVarsEnd		EQU		SelfSend+2				; End of MPP vars (*** more in LAPvars.a ***)
MPPVARSEND.restored: MPPVarsEnd EQU LUQElPtr+4 ; End of MPP vars (*** more in LAPvars.a ***)

WDSPTR.original: WDSPtr			EQU		OurVars.MPPVarsEnd		; (4) WDS pointer saved here on writes
WDSPTR.restored: WDSPtr EQU MPPVarsEnd ; (4) WDS pointer saved here on writes

VABORTWAIT.original: VAbortWait		EQU		FirstVWord				; (2) Constant for sending abort bits (3.2B)

SAVEA45.original: SaveA45			EQU		VWordsEnd				; (8) A4 and A5 saved here on interrupt
SAVEA45.restored: SaveA45 EQU VAbortWait+1 ; (8) A4 and A5 saved here on interrupt

DATASIZE.original: DataSize		EQU		StatsEnd				; Size of our data with stats

limitations: The original module headers, full histories and most implementation comments are unavailable. The reconstruction does not claim to recover their exact spelling or source-file boundaries.
Several private field offsets changed after the Mac Plus. The evidence records restored declarations and their original lines separately.
The full meaning of MPPVersionWord remains uncertain. Its two bytes match the ROM and are outside every known code entry.
Verification establishes assembled bytes, data boundaries and label addresses. It does not exercise LocalTalk hardware timing, disk polling, network traffic or interrupt races.

verification.method: Translated the final MPW source, assembled for the 68000, linked at $41A6F2, rejected unresolved relocations and compared every byte with the ROM. Checked every recorded code and data label.

prose_lint.scope: Authored source comments and evidence prose. Preserved original comments were excluded.
